title: `teploy cloud status --json` (rev 22, cloud-v1): the Teploy Cloud URL, the stored organization and whether the stored API key works. Exits 0 under --json whatever the key check says; key_works and error are the report.

key_works.description: false when not logged in or when Teploy Cloud refused the key.

error.description: Why the key check failed; absent when it passed or was not run.
